description:
Sr Analyst

Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh

**Job Summary**
---------------

### **Job Title**

**Software Development Engineer (E1.2)**

### **Role Summary**

The Software Development Engineer (E1.2) is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software solutions that meet business and customer requirements. The role requires strong technical expertise, problem-solving abilities, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable software applications and services.
* Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following engineering best practices.
* Participate in requirement analysis, technical design, and code reviews.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve software defects and performance issues.
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, QA engineers, and stakeholders.
* Contribute to system architecture, design discussions, and technical documentation.
* Ensure compliance with security, quality, and coding standards.
* Support production systems, monitor application health, and implement fixes as needed.
* Continuously improve development processes, tools, and automation.

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* Relevant experience in software development.
* Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, C#, Python, JavaScript, or similar.
* Understanding of software design principles, data structures, and algorithms.
* Experience with databases, APIs, and version control systems (e.g., Git).
* Knowledge of Agile/Scrum development methodologies.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Understanding of microservices architecture and containerization technologies.
* Exposure to automated testing frameworks.

### **Key Competencies**

* Problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Customer-focused mindset.
* Learning agility and adaptability.
* Ownership and accountability for deliverables.

### **Success Measures**

* Quality and timeliness of software deliverables.
* Code quality and adherence to engineering standards.
* Contribution to team objectives and technical initiatives.
* Reduction of defects and operational issues.
* Continuous improvement and innovation contributions.

If this is for a specific company or internal leveling framework, I can tailor the JD accordingly.

title: Quality Engineering Manager (Java, Python, GenAI, Selenium, Playwright)
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Delivery Leadership & Governance
* Lead Scrum planning, execution, defect management, and release validation activities
* Define and implement standards, processes, templates, and best practices
* Establish quality gates and readiness checkpoints to ensure successful production releases
* Drive risk assessment and mitigation strategies for critical business initiatives
* Provide quality status reporting and executive-level communication
* Stakeholder Partnership
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Business Operations, and Program teams to ensure business requirements are testable and validated
* Facilitate requirement reviews and acceptance criteria assessments
* Serve as the primary point of contact for business acceptance and release readiness discussions
* Align testing strategies with business priorities and organizational goals
* Test Strategy & Execution
* Develop comprehensive UAT strategies covering:
* Functional testing
* End-to-end validation
* Regression testing
* Integration testing
* Business process validation
* Ensure full test coverage and traceability from requirements to test results
* Oversee defect triage and resolution activities
* Quality Engineering & Automation
* Drive adoption of test automation and AI-assisted testing practices
* Identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency, quality, and delivery speed
* Promote shift-left testing practices and quality engineering principles
* Evaluate and implement tools and capabilities that enhance testing effectiveness
* Team Leadership
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of UAT analysts and quality engineers
* Conduct performance management, coaching, and career development activities
* Manage resource planning, workload balancing, and capability development
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and innovation
* Metrics & Continuous Improvement
* Establish and monitor KPIs including:
* Defect leakage
* UAT execution progress
* Test coverage
* Release readiness metrics
* Automation adoption metrics
* Drive root cause analysis and process improvement initiatives
* Support operational excellence and modernization efforts
  
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field
* 7+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, QA, or UAT
* 3+ years of people leadership experience
* Experience managing testing activities for large-scale enterprise applications
* Experience with defect management and test management tools
* Solid understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Agile, and release management processes
* Proven solid stakeholder management and communication skills
* Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*
